title: Stage Contract and Preview Approval
purpose: Lock the aesthetic-engine Coming Soon stage and obtain approval for the reference-inspired image-trail direction before product UI code.
acceptance: Live branch, HEAD, dirty files, checkpoint, product sources, design sources, and CodePen reference behavior are recorded.
The stage has explicit scope, exclusions, completion evidence, delayed-commit policy, and push authorization.
Desktop, mobile, and dual-theme preview images exist before any aesthetic-engine UI implementation.
The approved direction explicitly adapts to the existing Light and Dark semantic theme systems instead of hard-coding one dark aesthetic.
The approved motion direction uses a fixed 2:3 trail-card frame system based on the reference behavior, not image-native random dimensions.
The user explicitly approves the preview direction.

title: Medical Theme Image Asset Pack

acceptance: At least six themed raster assets exist in the workspace and are suitable for the cursor-trail effect.
Assets depict report structure, PPT reconstruction, research poster, evidence table, clinical decision path, and dossier material without patient faces or real records.

title: Reference-Inspired Coming Soon Surface
purpose: Implement the approved central 敬请期待 page with a restrained image-trail interaction based on the reference behavior.
acceptance: RED proves the page, central copy, image-trail assets, and no-upload boundary are absent before implementation.
The page renders one h1 containing 敬请期待 and the fixed Coming Soon explanation from the IA.
Pointer movement creates a bounded trail of themed images with distance/time throttling, rotation, scale, fade-out, and cleanup.
Every spawned trail item uses one fixed portrait frame size with object-fit cover; desktop targets the reference-like 200x300 proportion and mobile scales it down consistently.
Trail chaos is bounded by max simultaneous items, movement threshold, spawn interval, short lifetime, and z-index ordering.
Colors, borders, surfaces, text, and accents consume or match the existing Light/Dark semantic theme system.
The implementation materially matches the approved preview without copying unrelated reference content or adding a new animation dependency.

title: Motion, Accessibility, and Responsive Verification
purpose: Prove the page works across desktop/mobile, keyboard, dark/light themes, and reduced-motion without letting effects hide content.
acceptance: Focused tests, full tests, token tests, TypeScript, production build, and git diff checks pass.
Browser QA covers /aesthetic-engine at desktop 1280x720 and mobile 390x844 in light and dark themes.
Light mode reads as a clinical white archive and dark mode reads as a dark clinical judgment archive, with all key text and controls contrast-safe.
Dynamic QA confirms trail cards remain uniform in size and do not overlap the central copy into an unreadable state during rapid pointer movement.
Reduced-motion stops continuous pointer trails and keeps the Coming Soon message and application link immediately visible.
The page has one h1, no horizontal overflow, no console errors, and mobile touch targets are at least 44px.

title: Dependency Closure, Exact Commit, and Push

scope: all files created or modified by T02-T06
acceptance: All previous Tasks are passed with fresh evidence.
The diff contains no unrelated dirty files and is staged with an exact allowlist.
The stage is committed once all checks pass, with clean-HEAD dependency closure verified.
